p1: [low, ominous] In nineteen eighty-five, L.A.'s most feared killer came home... [whispers] and saw his own face on every newspaper.
[low] They called him... the Night Stalker.
[low] For over a year, he crept into homes at night, through unlocked doors and windows.
[low] Then a witness wrote down the plate of his car.
[low] Inside it, police found... one fingerprint.
[low, ominous] It matched a man named Richard Ramirez.
[low] His photo went out on TV and in the papers.
[low, tense] He came back from Arizona... [whispers] and his own face was staring back at him.
[low] A woman saw him... and screamed, [shouting] "The killer!"
[low, tense] He ran. He tried to steal a car... and a crowd held him down until police arrived.
[low] It wasn't the police who caught the Night Stalker. [low, ominous] It was his neighbours.
[low] Convicted of thirteen murders, he said... [whispers] "See you in Disneyland."
[low] He died in prison in twenty thirteen. [low, ominous] Never executed.
